nativePlatform.dimensions: dp for layout; sp for scalable type
nativePlatform.previewPolicy: Native component metadata only; HTML/CSS previews would misrepresent Android controls.

narrative.overview: Inherit maestro-lite’s confirmed native Material 3 world: charcoal actions, paper reading surfaces, a cool gray backdrop and restrained hierarchy. Native Android conventions govern controls, keyboard handling, navigation and dialogs. Hue stays muted; status always includes readable text.
keyCharacteristics: Conversation content leads; terminal output is a separate diagnostic view.
Light and dark palettes use corresponding Material color roles.
Selectable reading text, scalable sp typography and 48dp minimum actions.
dos: Do inherit theme color roles for custom content and retain native control behavior.
Do keep updates quiet and questions actionable, with status readable without color.
Do preserve scroll and drafts during live refreshes.
Do wrap native action groups to the available width, including lifecycle and recovery controls.
donts: Don't turn a terminal snapshot into an interactive terminal or a substitute for the conversation.
Don't introduce production data into demonstration screenshots.

rules.name: The Theme Roles Rule
rules.body: Custom content resolves its colors from the active native theme rather than choosing a separate light or dark palette.

rules.name: The Reading Type Rule
rules.body: Use native scalable text for conversation content and reserve monospace for terminal output.

rules.name: The Visible Actions Rule
rules.body: Action groups wrap at the available width so navigation and recovery controls remain discoverable without a horizontal gesture.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Native filled MaterialButton for Pair device, Send and the first question option.

native.states: Native ripple, focus and disabled treatment.

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Native text action for navigation and secondary or lifecycle controls.

components.name: Wrapping action group
components.description: Fully visible navigation and recovery buttons wrap into rows at the available width.

native.measurement: Children measured AT_MOST the available width; next control wraps when it would overflow.

components.name: Connection field
components.description: Persistent-label native outlined fields for pairing and token fallback.

native.states: Inherited native Material focus, selection and input behavior.

components.name: Reading container
components.description: Flat paper containers for agent rows and message content; outgoing messages reverse ink and paper.

components.name: Conversation composer
components.description: Fixed multiline native EditText with a labeled Send button outside the scrolling conversation.

native.sendState: Disabled for empty drafts or an in-flight send.

components.name: Terminal snapshot
components.description: Separate selectable, read-only diagnostic output preserving terminal line width.

native.scrolling: Vertical ScrollView containing a HorizontalScrollView; action groups above still wrap.
